verdict.rationale: SerpApi is an HTTP API driven entirely by API key, so it runs headlessly by design. Official client libraries let scripts call it directly (`GoogleSearch({...,'api_key':...}).get_dict()`). It also offers async submit-and-retrieve, structured JSON/markdown output, and an MCP integration for agent automation. A community report notes that putting the API key in the URL rather than a header or env var complicates secret management in automated pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, header/env-var-based credential handling, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s), independent hands-on CI corroboration.
